label: PF Backlog 48
title: Discovery panel prompt timeout silently accepts the recommendation (owner wants to verify each)
body: Observed: core/interactive.ask() for a discovery-panel question fell back to the default after PIPELINE_PROMPT_TIMEOUT (3600s) and core/discovery_panel.record_answers() treats an empty answer as 'accept the recommendation' - so an unanswered question is recorded as accepted with NO explicit owner decision (P27 was auto-accepted this way). Owner wants to verify each answer. Fix options: (a) do not auto-accept on timeout - mark the question as 'timed_out/unanswered' and require an explicit accept; (b) raise/allow per-question timeout; (c) surface timed-out questions to the dashboard for review. Refs: core/interactive.py:ask(), core/discovery_panel.py:record_answers().

decisions.note: [P3] Prompt timeout must not silently accept; require explicit accept.

_note: verified: empty/timed-out discovery answer is now 'unanswered' (needs_verification), not auto-accepted; only explicit 'accept' accepts

dashboard_impact.reason: HIL prompt/approval surface exists (dashboard HIL decision dialog)
